security_model: Phase 1: Hermez PPOT, sound if any one PPOT contributor deleted their entropy. Phase 2: one secret contribution by a single operator, entropy discarded, followed by a public drand beacon fixed after the contribution hash. Soundness of phase 2 rests on that one operator having discarded the entropy. Devnet only; a multi-party phase 2 is required before mainnet.
